comparison.objective: Extract a retaining pin while supporting a weighted carriage; candidate adjusts damping on an isolated robot axis.
comparison.physical_skill: Load support during pin extraction versus setscrew unlocking, fine collar rotation, relocking and repeated impact-response assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Body reports a full demo and unsafe-event check but provides no complete numeric scoring rubric or spec version; candidate has explicit energy, velocity, stroke and two-cycle thresholds.
comparison.reason: Even with missing rubric details, load-preserving fastener extraction is clearly different from tuning and validating a damper.
